about: Candidates, not yet creatures: fifty more new kinds put together from kit parts by rule (tools/kitgen/round3.py), for Zac to pick from. Round three: ten silhouettes that rounds one and two and the six orders do not have, built to the same grammar as round two and checked against the designed species' range (measures). Ten plans, five of each. Recipes are in kit-creatures.json's format (part ids and placements on a 400-wide canvas, centre line x = 200; every placement free, its mirror image beside it). Names are working names, taken from the species whose part is the candidate's largest.

plans.rule: Broad flat body, two jointed arms that end in a claw, small legs beneath.
A small body under a half-circle of long blades.
A mantle, two eyes, and a skirt of curling arms.
A heavy head and one long tail, with streamers swung out in an S.
A wide bell, frilled arms in the middle, a fringe hanging from the rim.
A long stalk, a cup, a crown of feathered arms; it does not travel, so no head.
A head, a body slung between three pairs of jointed legs.
The great wings closed over the body to a point, a head peeping out.
A trunk that forks and forks again; it does not travel, so no head.
A body bent into a circle round a small mass, head meeting tail.
